title: UL-12 — Challenge: Step Functions
scenario: Extend Step Functions with failure, Retry, and Catch handling.
acceptanceCriteria: Name the resources you create `workbook-ul12`: state machine `workbook-ul12`, role `workbook-ul12-sfn`, and, if you use a Lambda task, function `workbook-ul12-task` with role `workbook-ul12-lambda`. Tag each one LabId=ul-12.
State machine includes intentional failure branch.
Retry policy configured on task state.
Catch block routes failure to cleanup Pass state.
Successful path still reachable with valid input.
Execution history shows retry attempt count.
IAM role scoped to Lambda or mock task only.
CloudWatch logs not required but if enabled, removed in teardown.
Teardown deletes state machine before role.
stopChargesPanel: Stop running executions, delete the state machine, its log group and any Lambda task, then the IAM roles for ul-12.

orderedDeletesPowerShell: # Lost an ID? aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-12

if ($SmArn -and $SmArn -ne 'None') { foreach ($ExecArn in (aws stepfunctions list-executions --state-machine-arn $SmArn --status-filter RUNNING --query "executions[].[executionArn]" --output text)) { if ($ExecArn) { aws stepfunctions stop-execution --execution-arn $ExecArn } } }

foreach ($P in (aws iam list-attached-role-policies --role-name workbook-ul12-sfn --query "AttachedPolicies[].[PolicyArn]" --output text)) { if ($P) { aws iam detach-role-policy --role-name workbook-ul12-sfn --policy-arn $P } }

foreach ($P in ((aws iam list-role-policies --role-name workbook-ul12-sfn --query PolicyNames --output text) -split '\s+')) { if ($P -and $P -ne 'None') { aws iam delete-role-policy --role-name workbook-ul12-sfn --policy-name $P } }
# Only if you created the Lambda task role:

foreach ($P in (aws iam list-attached-role-policies --role-name workbook-ul12-lambda --query "AttachedPolicies[].[PolicyArn]" --output text)) { if ($P) { aws iam detach-role-policy --role-name workbook-ul12-lambda --policy-arn $P } }

foreach ($P in ((aws iam list-role-policies --role-name workbook-ul12-lambda --query PolicyNames --output text) -split '\s+')) { if ($P -and $P -ne 'None') { aws iam delete-role-policy --role-name workbook-ul12-lambda --policy-name $P } }
verification: aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-12 returns an empty ResourceTagMappingList in $env:AWS_REGION
aws iam get-role --role-name workbook-ul12-sfn returns NoSuchEntity
teardown.stillBillingNote: Time already used, transfer, tax, and 8–12h billing lag may still appear. Alerts do not delete resources.
teardown.recovery: If teardown fails, stop. Confirm $env:AWS_REGION is us-east-1 and the caller is not root. Run aws sts get-caller-identity and type that Account value before any delete. List LabId=ul-12 with aws resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources --tag-filters Key=LabId,Values=ul-12. Delete only those ids. Never delete untagged resources.

beforeYouStart: Read the paired guided lab (gl-12) stop-charges panel before you create anything.
Set $env:AWS_PROFILE and $env:AWS_REGION. Do not use the root user.
